metaDescription: Browse our selection of custom badges for your next promotion. Perfect for events, uniforms, and branding. Start your order today.
introHtml: Custom badges are a versatile way to promote your brand, recognize employees, or identify staff at events. Whether you need metal badges for a polished look, woven badges for apparel, or PVC badges for durability, our range of options makes it easy to find the right style. As a starting point for exploring the category, we offer a broad selection of shapes, sizes, and attachment types. Browse our collection to see what works for your team or event, and get a quote on the quantities and designs you need.
heroAltText: Assorted custom badges with metal, woven, and PVC options for branding and identification
